name: Disable Inking & Typing Personalization
description: Disables the collection of inking and typing data used to improve handwriting recognition, text suggestions, and language input personalization.

description_i18n.en: Disables the collection of inking and typing data used to improve handwriting recognition, text suggestions, and language input personalization.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Erfassung von Daten für Handschriftenerkennung und Textvorschläge. Dies reduziert Hintergrundprozesse und kann Kompatibilitätsprobleme verhindern.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la collecte de données d'écriture et de frappe pour améliorer la reconnaissance manuscrite et les suggestions de texte.

warnings.title: required
warnings.message: This tweak requires an elevated administrator session to apply changes and modify system registry settings

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value AllowLinguisticDataCollection under HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\TextInput to disable linguistic data collection
